elements.element: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an affiliate (unqualified right)
elements.evidence: "no such approval shall be required for an assignment by Client to a financially responsible affiliate" — the affiliate right remains qualified by a financial-responsibility test not permitted by the preferred position

elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to a successor in merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets
elements.evidence: "or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets"

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent, not to be unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: "Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights ... without the prior written approval of the other party, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed"

elements.element: Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor
elements.evidence: "TrueLink shall not assign or transfer this Agreement to a competitor of Client."

elements.element: No Vendor termination right on Customer's change of control
elements.evidence: "No change of control of Client shall ... give rise to any right of TrueLink to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement."

elements.element: Mutual right to assign to successors with written notice
elements.evidence: the successor carve-out runs only to "an assignment by Client"; no written-notice mechanic appears

elements.element: Consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: "which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed"

offending_extra_words: No change of control of Client shall constitute an assignment requiring approval
reasons: Preferred level incomplete: Customer's consent-free affiliate assignment is still conditioned on the affiliate being "financially responsible"; the preferred position requires an unqualified affiliate right, so the retained qualifier should have been deleted.

Fallback level is also incomplete (Vendor-side successor right and written-notice mechanic absent), so the clause cannot fall back to the alternative bargain; however, the drafter's locked target is preferred and the only gap there is the financial qualifier.

Minimality fails: the operation rewrites the whole sentence and expands 37 words to 104 (ratio 2.81) with changed-character ratio 0.637 above the 0.600 limit; a shorter targeted insertion plus a separate sentence would suffice.

Extra scope beyond the preferred position: "or delayed", "suspend or re-price", and the deemed-assignment change-of-control rule add protections the preferred position does not call for (deterministic check confirms preferred assignment adds no change-of-control deemed-assignment rule).
Intent preserved: no undefined terms, contradictions, or dangling mechanics; unrelated terms untouched and the mutual consent obligation remains effective.
